newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan financials rise further to boost market.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan financials rise further to boost market.

text.p: Taiwan's most heavily weighted financials rose further at mid-morning on Monday on the heels of the sector's 5.84 percent Saturday surge, helping the overall index break resistance at 8,600 points, brokers said.

Financials opened with a bang, rising nearly two percent, and after 77 minutes, at 0217 GMT, were still in positive territory, up 0.58 percent. Despite the fading rise, brokers said the heavily weighted sector remained the main driving force behind a 1.46 percent main index rise.
"Financials' continous rise, though not very strong, effectively boosts sentiment and has helped the index break resistance at 8,600," said HSBC James Capel analyst Alex Chen.
Cathay Life was up T$4.5 or 3.03 percent at T$153 and China Development had gained T$1 or 0.83 percent at T$122.
Chen cited a typical pattern in which a rise in financials is generally accompanied by a decline in industrial sectors and vice versa -- but said Monday's situation was different.
"This time financials and industrials are rising together, indicating how bullish the sentiment is," Chen said.
Before their big gains on Saturday and Monday, financial shares largely had lagged behind the overall market's recent rally, he said.
